observations: Blue and black high-pressure water machine.
Power cord is coiled around the body.
The machine is resting on a light-colored wooden surface.
A watermark 'DANCOLE FURNITURE TEXTURES' is visible across the center of the image.
No brand name or model number is visible on the front or side of the unit.

claims.claim: pre-certified to work at the peak of their performance
claims.evidence: Requires a video of the machine running and the water pressure gauge showing a high reading.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not be functional or may have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on and the pressure gauge reaching a high pressure.

risks.risk: The item may be a generic or low-quality brand rather than a Bosch or similar premium brand.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's label or the brand logo on the side or back.

risks.risk: The power cord may be damaged or the plug may be missing.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the plug and the entire length of the cord.
risks.if_unproven: as missing the plug and cord

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine plugged in and running with the pressure gauge.
Close-up photo of the brand logo and model number on the machine.
Photo of the power plug and the full length of the cord.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
